description: For each nationality, count every constructor result record (constructor-race entries). The baseline is the average of these record counts across nationalities.

c.request: For each constructor nationality, what are the total points in the constructor results (ignoring missing points)? How many constructor entries does it have in the results, and how far is that above or below the average across nationalities? For each nationality, count every constructor result record (constructor-race entries). The baseline is the average of these record counts across nationalities.
c.sql: WITH nat_stats AS (SELECT c.nationality, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM constructorResults cr JOIN constructors c ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId GROUP BY c.nationality) SELECT nationality, total_points, record_count, record_count - (SELECT AVG(record_count) FROM nat_stats) AS diff_from_avg FROM nat_stats;

a.request: For each constructor `nationality`, show the total points from constructor results (ignoring missing points) and the number of constructor result records, i.e. constructor-race entries. Also show how far that number is above or below the average number across all nationalities (unrounded).
a.sql: WITH nat AS (SELECT c.nationality AS nationality, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points, COUNT(*) AS result_count FROM constructorResults cr JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId GROUP BY c.nationality) SELECT nationality, total_points, result_count, result_count - AVG(result_count) OVER () AS diff_from_avg FROM nat;

b.request: For each constructor nationality, count the constructorResults rows (constructor-race entries) joined to constructors by constructorId, sum constructorResults.points ignoring NULLs, and report how far each nationality's record count is above or below the average record count across nationalities
b.sql: WITH nat AS (SELECT c.nationality, COUNT(*) AS record_count, SUM(cr.points) AS total_points FROM constructorResults cr JOIN constructors c ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId GROUP BY c.nationality) SELECT nationality, record_count, total_points, record_count - AVG(record_count) OVER () AS diff_from_avg FROM nat;

d.request: For each constructor nationality, how many constructor result records (constructor-race entries) does it have, and how far is that count above or below the average record count across all nationalities?
d.sql: WITH nat_counts AS (SELECT c.nationality, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM constructorResults cr JOIN constructors c ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId GROUP BY c.nationality) SELECT nationality, record_count, record_count - AVG(record_count) OVER () AS diff_from_avg FROM nat_counts;
